video_title: Kobe, Shaq, McGrady, Tim Duncan and Kevin Garnett's team is the BEST All-NBA team EVER 👀

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the 2003 All-NBA team to the 1988 squad
quotes.excerpt: I don't think nobody is beating this team.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Is this the best first team of all time? 1988 had Magic, MJ, Larry, Charles, and Hakeem. 2003 had Kobe, Tracy, Kevin, Tim, and Shaq.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Man, I don't think nobody is beating this team. I'm sorry.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the 2003 All-NBA team's size and talent
quotes.excerpt: You got three seven-footers, a six-nine shooting guard, and a six-seven point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You got three seven-footers, a six-nine shooting guard, and a six-seven point guard. Boy, boy, boy.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett's defensive versatility in the 2003 era
quotes.excerpt: KG could definitely guard threes back then. He's not 2008 KG.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: KG could definitely move back then. He could definitely guard threes back then. He's not 2008 KG.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He definitely could guard Tracy McGrady, bro.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The dominance of Tim Duncan and Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.excerpt: You got Tim Duncan and Shaq? I'm sorry, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You got Tim Duncan and Shaq? I'm sorry, man.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.excerpt: 88 is Magic, Larry, MJ, Charles Barkley, and Hakeem Olajuwon.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: 88 is Magic, Larry, MJ, Charles Barkley, and Hakeem Olajuwon.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: That's a hell of a team to kill, though.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Jordan's scoring dominance in the 1988 season
quotes.excerpt: This is Michael Jordan where he was giving people 40 a game.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: This is Michael Jordan where he was giving people 40 a game.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, this is like 35 points a game MJ.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: The lack of a traditional point guard in 2003
quotes.excerpt: 2003 doesn't have a real point guard. Magic will be able to.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: 2003 doesn't have a real point guard. As much as we talk about Kobe, I'm sure Kobe could do it if he wanted to, he's still not a point guard naturally. Magic will be able to.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Once Kobe starts seeing MJ cook, he's going to want to go back. Magic is going to keep playing that game and just passing that rock.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Hakeem Olajuwon's physical strength and defensive presence
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Hakeem all day just rubs his hand on the concrete.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I feel like Hakeem all day just rubs his hand on the concrete. That's how his hand feels. The man got strong, this man is. His hands. He's a shot blocker, too.
